title: pm-dispatch(execution-duties): per-card effort drops from `high` to `medium` for review-nit follow-ups, same-family edge cards and copy- or changeset-only touch-ups; epic cards join the `xhigh` list (Sales 2026-11-12)
body:
coordinator#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUryPC4A9RDaGRsq4W

Filing gate: ③ 维护者直派 (a pm rule change, filed only because the maintainer named it; relayed by the project coordinator). Filed from project thread "Update pm-dispatch effort rules" (`cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuUZ9URKazdwZeWD8MWEd9Bn`, project chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu). ⛔ Not a claim.

**Maintainer's words, verbatim.** Sales, project chat, 2026-11-12T17:16:42Z: 「待办任务很多，是否建议尝试降低任务的effort」. The project coordinator answered at 17:16:49Z with the proposal below. Sales, 2026-11-12T17:17:18Z: 「同意，立卡更新 skills」.

The part of the proposal that is a rule, verbatim (the coordinator's words, which the maintainer agreed to):

> - **不降**：专题卡、p1 卡、安全卡、红线复读，继续用 xhigh。
> - **可以降**：评审 nit 的跟进卡、同族合并的边角卡、纯文案或 changeset 的小改，从 high 降到 medium。

The proposal's third bullet (open more seats, raise concurrency) is a per-project word of the maintainer, not skill text, and is out of this card.

**Governing text.** `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md` 〈派发〉, read at `origin/main` 88282a78:
- 「effort 按卡难度定,与档位、降档理由写进 Container & model 行与派发令,显式传参,⛔ 不留空。」
- 「S 机械 `medium`;M `high`(默认);L/XL/security/p1/契约复核/四轴分析/ADR `xhigh`;`max` 凭点名/常设令。」
- Pointers that only say "effort by card difficulty" and repeat no list: `coordinator.md` section 四, `dispatch-runbook.md` 〈卡线程〉, and the `Container & model:` line of the claim template in `SKILL.md`.

**What is wrong today.** The effort line knows three sizes and one default. Every card that is not S-mechanical and not on the `xhigh` list dispatches at `high`, so a card whose whole content is a reviewer's nit, an edge member of a family that already landed its main fix, or a wording or changeset correction costs the same as an M card with a design judgment in it. With a long backlog that is spend with no return: these cards have their answer written on them before dispatch. In the other direction, the text does not name epic cards, so a seat reads an M-sized epic card as `high` although one rework round on a serial epic chain costs more than the effort it saved.

**Wanted.** Amend the effort rule in `execution-duties.md` 〈派发〉 so that it says, in these words or tighter:
- **`medium`, down from `high`, for three kinds of card that would otherwise be M:**
  - a review-nit follow-up card (a card carrying only `nit`-level findings of a review of record, `contract-review.md`);
  - a same-family edge card (an edge member folded into, or left over from, a family whose main fix is ruled and landed);
  - a copy-only or changeset-only touch-up (wording, or `.changeset/*` text, with no behaviour or contract change).
- **`xhigh` stays, and outranks the three above:** L/XL, `security`, p1, contract review (the proposal's 「红线复读」: a review of record, a re-read of a new head included), four-axis analysis and ADR cards, as today; **epic cards** (a child of an epic parent, `seat-lifecycle.md` 〈Epic 子树车道〉) join the list. A nit follow-up that is p1, `security` or an epic child is `xhigh`, not `medium`.
- Unchanged: S mechanical `medium`; M `high` as the default; `max` only by a named word or a standing order; mandatory clause ① and the tier rules; seat sessions at `high` (`seat-lifecycle.md`).
- The claim's `Container & model:` line names which of the three kinds a `medium` rests on, as it already names the reason for any step down.

**Line budget, measured.** `execution-duties.md` is 189 lines against a ceiling of 189 (headroom 0), and the two effort lines are 119 and 120 bytes against the 120-byte line budget (`node scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`). The rule therefore needs one more line: paid by a deletion in the same file, or by a ceiling raise of the measured increment that cites the ruling record on this card, as the ratchet's own rule allows. ⛔ No re-wrap to find the line.

**Acceptance.**
- `execution-duties.md` 〈派发〉 states the three `medium` kinds, epic cards on the `xhigh` list, and that the `xhigh` list wins where both apply.
- `SKILL.md`, `coordinator.md` and `dispatch-runbook.md` are untouched unless one of them is measured to contradict the new text (today they only point).
- `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` and `pnpm check:pm-skill-id-lint` are green.

Reader who acts: the `domain:skills` seat (an os-dev on `.claude/**`; `references/**` only, so default-judgment tier with the seat's contract review at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`; Tier S landing after a PASS of record). The maintainer's project already dispatches by this rule from the words above; the card makes the skill say it for every project.

Dedupe (open AND closed): `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue effort in:title` → 8 hits; nearest #28901 (closed: seat sessions at `high`), #29741 (closed: docs-only ADR cards at `xhigh` by standing order), #25729 (closed: `docs/adr/**` tier and `xhigh` floor), #25185 (closed: card threads and effort by difficulty). None lowers an effort or names epic cards. `is:issue is:open label:domain:skills xhigh` → 1 hit, a seat post. **New.**

Clause-②: no · Metadata-protocol: none · skip-changeset (`.claude/**` is not published).

Suggested-grade: p2 · rules text only; a maintainer-directed rule the fleet's dispatch cost rides on (same grade as #28901 and #29741).
